title: 第二千六百五十八章 沐云的关注下第二千六百五十七章 沐云的关注中
content_zh:
魔法少女职业，在二次元宇宙可谓毁誉参半。其本身虽象征着真善美，具有极高的潜力和上限，对邪恶阵营有着极强的克制能力，但其本身也存在着极大的隐患。
正所谓物极必反，过刚易折。
不管是意志被削弱，还是精神受到污染，当魔法少女的意志不足以控制其所拥有的力量，轻则丧失身为魔法少女的力量，重则扭曲黑化，变成所谓的【魔女】。
或者更准确地说，魔法少女本身就是从魔女演化而成的职业，本身残留着混乱阵营的基因，一旦失控就会从守序阵营向混乱阵营滑落。
沐云要是把魔法少女的传承丢到特摄领，以玩家们的尿性，不出事的可能基本为零。
沐云虽然喜欢给自己找乐子，却没打算把自己变成乐子。搬石头砸自己的脚，这种事情沐云可不干。
摇了摇头，沐云就把思绪收了回来，转而观察起其他玩家的最新动态。
艾洛西亚等重生者、疯人院工会、颠疯工会、启奏、风花雪月、风之波尔切、蔚蓝水波……
不多时，沐云就把他重点关注的个人和势力的近期动态，通通审视过了一遍。
其中，沐云最关注的莫过于启奏和蔚蓝水波的动作。
启奏用脉络下位符文附带的工艺鼓捣出来的小铁片，在二次元宇宙属于嵌套符文组的一种，其优点是制造难度较低，可以进行量产并成规模列装，若作为镶嵌物使用的话，还能按照实际需求来调整符文阵列。
但其缺点也很明显，就是整体性能相对较差，在中低层次的战场和特定领域用一用还行，再往上就不行了。
因为层次品质越高，嵌套符文组这种【拼装货】和一体成型的【原装货】的差距也就越大。
话虽如此，嵌套符文组对现阶段玩家来说，还是非常好用的。
不过，相较于用来制作一般的武器装备，沐云更希望玩家们把嵌套符文组用在攻城器械的制作上。
相较于床弩、弩炮和投石机，火炮才是真正的大杀器，《帝望》诸国各方势力基本上都有自己的火炮，只是具体的类型不一样而已。
以大汉帝国为例，其拥有的火炮名为龙虎炮，也就是所谓的龙炮和虎炮。龙虎炮的整体造型类似迫击炮式的一次性火箭筒，只是龙炮的体积较大，跟柱子没啥两样，没有做专门的脚架，一般多用投石机来充当它的发射架。
龙虎炮的威力极大，但造价同样感人，再加上运输和保存等方面的问题，鲜少用于正面战场，更多是作为一种威慑武器而存在。
（注：有关于龙虎炮的内容描述，取材三国群英传等游戏的原着设定，与原史无关，在此特别说明。）
也正因火炮的威力太过强大，原住民npc势力对其管控得也更加严苛，现阶段玩家根本接触不到。

玩家当前能接触到的火炮，仅有魔兽领工程学所附带的那种。
不是说以魔兽领工程学制作出来的火炮不行，而是玩家当前的生活职业水平不够，接触不到更高级别的稀有配方，制作出来的火炮还比不上玩家们自制的弩炮和投石机。
至少，床弩、弩炮和投石机这些攻城器械，玩家们只要舍得堆料，用大把大把的高层次高品质资源去砸，将其战力能级砸到c级巅峰都不是问题。
嵌套符文组对现阶段玩家来说，就相当于一个作弊器，一个可以让玩家们提前拥有高阶火炮的媒介！
content_en:
The magical girl profession has mixed reputations and reputations in the two-dimensional universe. Although it itself symbolizes truth, goodness and beauty, has extremely high potential and upper limit, and has a strong ability to restrain the evil camp, it also has great hidden dangers.
As the saying goes, things must be reversed if they are extreme; if they are too strong, they will easily break.
Whether her will is weakened or her spirit is polluted, when a magical girl's will is not able to control the power she possesses, she will lose her power as a magical girl at best, or become twisted and blackened into a so-called "witch" at worst.
Or to be more precise, magical girls themselves are a profession that evolved from witches, and they retain the genes of the chaotic camp. Once they lose control, they will slip from the lawful camp to the chaotic camp.
If Mu Yun throws the inheritance of magical girls into the special shooting field, the possibility of nothing happening will be basically zero based on the players' urination.
Although Mu Yun likes to have fun for himself, he has no intention of turning himself into fun. Mu Yun would not do anything like shooting himself in the foot.
Shaking his head, Mu Yun put his thoughts back and turned to observe the latest developments of other players.
Aelosia and other reborns, the Lunatic Asylum Guild, the Crazy Guild, Qi Zuo, Fenghuaxueyue, Wind Porche, Blue Water Waves...
Not long after, Mu Yun reviewed the recent developments of the individuals and forces that he focused on.
Among them, Mu Yun was most concerned about the movements of Qizou and Azure Water Waves.
The small iron piece that Qi Zuo used to tinker with the craftsmanship attached to the lower runes of the veins is a type of nested rune group in the two-dimensional universe. Its advantage is that it is relatively easy to manufacture and can be mass-produced and installed on a large scale. If used as an inlay, the rune array can be adjusted according to actual needs.
However, its shortcomings are also obvious, that is, the overall performance is relatively poor. It is okay for use in mid- to low-level battlefields and specific fields, but not for higher levels.
Because the higher the level quality, the greater the gap between [assembled goods] such as nested rune sets and one-piece [original goods].
Having said that, nested rune groups are still very useful for players at this stage.
However, rather than using it to make general weapons and equipment, Mu Yun hopes that players will use nested rune groups to make siege equipment.
Compared with crossbows, ballistas and trebuchets, artillery is the real killer weapon. All the forces in the "Emperor's Hope" countries basically have their own artillery, but the specific types are different.
Take the Han Empire as an example. The artillery it owned was called the Dragon and Tiger Cannon, also known as the Dragon Cannon and Tiger Cannon. The overall shape of the Dragon Tiger Cannon is similar to a mortar-style disposable rocket launcher, except that the Dragon Cannon is larger in size and is no different from a pillar. It does not have a special tripod. Generally, a trebuchet is used as its launcher.
The Dragon Tiger Cannon is extremely powerful, but its cost is equally impressive. Coupled with problems in transportation and preservation, it is rarely used on frontal battlefields and exists more as a deterrent weapon.
(Note: The description of the content of the Dragon Tiger Cannon is based on the original settings of games such as Heroes of the Three Kingdoms and has nothing to do with the original history, so it is specially explained here.)
Precisely because the artillery is so powerful, the indigenous NPC forces have stricter control over it, and players cannot access it at this stage.
The only artillery that players currently have access to is the kind that comes with Warcraft Engineering.
It’s not that artillery made with Warcraft engineering is not good, but that players’ current living and professional standards are not enough and they don’t have access to higher-level rare formulas. The artillery produced is not as good as the players’ homemade crossbows and trebuchets.
At least, as long as players are willing to pile up materials and use a lot of high-level and high-quality resources to smash siege equipment such as bed crossbows, crossbows, and trebuchets, it is not a problem to smash their combat capabilities to the peak of C-level.
For players at this stage, the nested rune group is equivalent to a cheating device, a medium that allows players to possess high-level artillery in advance.介！
